title: Mothers` Day on Earth
author: Anindita Bose
text:
Women are blessed with the
consciousness of motherhood...

such a blissful energy on earth
such a powerful nurturing flow

I met two mothers : amma & ma

my life has been a blessed one,
a silent one - one which came to
experience life in all senses.

I lost them both, too soon, to tell
them what it means to be the
`mothers` to a daughter who could
win the world with words and
wisdom...

I was travelling through my own
karmic path and meeting the sages,
the wise souls and healers

I was creating communities with
the artists and visionaries...

but life has its own deals:
and I was unaware of its plan:
to call back both the women
in my life.

And everything changed,
nothing can be the same again,
the experiences, the people, the fact
that I am motherless...

the womb that carried me to this
world does not exist anymore...

I hope we shall meet again, in some
other space.

I will walk forward, since life will not
allow me to look back...

yet I wish that I had a mother alive,
to be loved and cherished,

not in memories but in flesh and blood.
